title: Align the ShopSphere API port
description: Make the frontend API base URL match the Spring Boot server port or configure both consistently.

title: Resolve the missing products route
description: Implement the requested endpoint if it is in scope, or remove the frontend request to the unsupported route.

title: Remove or complete datasource configuration
description: Keep the demo database-free by removing unused JPA/datasource settings, or declare and configure the intended JDBC driver.

title: Reduce default log verbosity
description: Use INFO or WARN for normal operation; enable DEBUG only when diagnosing a local issue.

title: Add the ShopSphere Vite entry file
description: Create the frontend root index.html with the application root and /src/main.jsx module entry, then rerun its build.
